items.prompt: In the stated binary payoff model, which objective leads to f=p-(1-p)/b before nonnegative clamping?

options.text: Maximize the probability of no losing outcomes.
options.why: The chosen fraction does not change the supplied probability of a losing outcome.

options.text: Maximize the worst-case wealth multiplier for 0<p<1.
options.why: For positive stakes the losing multiplier is 1-f; that is a different objective.

options.text: Maximize arithmetic expected wealth with no log transformation.
options.why: Expected wealth is linear in f here, unlike the strictly concave log-growth objective.

options.text: Maximize the expected logarithm of the wealth multiplier.
options.why: Differentiating p*log(1+b*f)+(1-p)*log(1-f) gives the stated stationary fraction.

items.explanation: Differentiating p*log(1+b*f)+(1-p)*log(1-f) gives the stated stationary fraction.
